scripts: "/Generate Tokens" test ["// For Convenience","var jsonData = JSON.parse(responseBody);","postman.setEnvironmentVariable(\"access_token\", jsonData.access_token);","postman.setEnvironmentVariable(\"refresh_token\", jsonData.refresh_token);","","// Tests ","pm.test(\"Response time is less than 500ms\", function () {","    pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(500);","});","","pm.test(\"Status code is 200\", function () {","    pm.response.to.have.status(200);","});","","pm.test(\"A bearer token is returned\", function () {","    var jsonData = pm.response.json();","    pm.expect(jsonData.token_type).to.eql(\"bearer\");","});","","var schema = {","  \"properties\": {","    \"access_token\": {","        \"type\": \"string\"","    },","    \"refresh_token\": {","        \"type\": \"string\"","    },","    \"created_at\": {","        \"type\": \"string\"","    },","    \"expires_in\": {","        \"type\": \"integer\"","    },","    \"token_type\": {","        \"type\": \"string\"","    },","    \"account_id\": {","        \"type\": \"integer\"","    }","  }","};","","pm.test('Schema is valid', function() {","  pm.expect(tv4.validate(jsonData, schema)).to.be.true;","});"]
